summary: HCW Biologics filed an 8-K reporting its exercise of an option to terminate an exclusive worldwide license agreement with Wugen Inc. for ex vivo rights to HCW9201 and HCW9206. The termination occurred on May 21, 2026, under a suspension letter agreement from May 30, 2025, triggered by the company entering a letter of intent with a third party. No price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing positions HCW to pursue commercialization through corporate partners in CAR-T and NK-cell therapies. This is a contract termination, not a deal termination under special-situations M&A.
